summary: Deliver a bounded TypeScript/Node HTTP sample that soft-holds inventory: an authorized opaque principal reserves quantity against a SKU for a TTL (reducing available stock), fails with named domain errors when stock is insufficient or the caller is unauthorized (no hold; stock unchanged), restores availability on authorized release or TTL expiry, and exposes checkable OpenAPI plus UML OCL with derived Vitest—without payments, multi-warehouse routing, full IAM, UI, notifications, or backorders beyond hard-fail.
goal: Authorized callers can soft-hold SKU quantity for a TTL and release holds; insufficient stock and unauthorized access fail with named domain errors without mutating stock; expired holds restore availability; HTTP/API and module contracts make these behaviors machine-checkable.
background: Greenfield solid_sdd evaluation sample. Demand, opaque-principal authZ, OpenAPI/OCL/Vitest paths, and out-of-scope product extras were settled before this brief; in-process stock and holds are a sample bound.

in_scope.text: WHEN an authorized opaque principal requests a soft-hold reservation of quantity against a SKU when available stock is at least the requested quantity THEN THE reservation service SHALL create a hold for a TTL and reduce available stock by that quantity
IF available stock is below the requested reserve quantity THEN THE reservation service SHALL fail with a named domain error, create no hold, and leave stock unchanged
IF the caller is unauthorized THEN THE reservation service SHALL fail with a named domain error on reserve or release, create no hold, and leave stock unchanged
WHEN an authorized opaque principal releases a hold THEN THE reservation service SHALL restore the held quantity to available stock
WHILE a hold is past its TTL THE reservation service SHALL treat the hold as expired and restore the held quantity to available stock
HTTP/API surface documented in OpenAPI that exposes reserve, release, and soft-hold lifecycle behaviors clients and tests can exercise
Module-level UML OCL contracts with derived Vitest tests that make soft-hold, authZ failure, and availability-restore behaviors checkable

out_of_scope.text: Multi-warehouse routing or cross-location inventory allocation
Full IAM product (SSO, OAuth UI, role admin) beyond opaque-principal authorize/deny for this sample
Notifications (email, push, webhooks) about holds or expiry
Backorders, waitlists, or deferred fulfillment beyond hard-fail when stock is below request
Durable shared persistence across process restarts beyond in-process stock and holds
Formal methods (e.g. TLA+) for concurrent hold races or distributed consistency

assumptions: AuthZ is opaque-principal allow/deny only; exact wire format (header/token shape) is deferred to OpenAPI apply
Exact HTTP paths, status codes, and error JSON shape are deferred to OpenAPI apply; named domain errors for insufficient stock and unauthorized remain required
Stock and holds are process-local / in-memory for this evaluation sample
TTL expiry is checkable; concrete default and clock source are deferred to OCL/apply
Initial SKU stock is established by a sample seed or implementation convention
constraints: UML OCL under contracts/**/*.ocl; derived Vitest under tests/contracts/**
Insufficient-stock and unauthorized failures must use named domain errors shared by API, OCL, and tests
Contract kind and density choices are deferred to solidsdd-judge; this brief only requires checkable HTTP/API and module surfaces
ChangeBrief only at this step: no Feature files, WorkPlan, OpenAPI, OCL, tests, or implementation edits as part of brief emission

success_criteria.text: An authorized opaque principal can reserve quantity against a SKU when stock allows; available stock decreases by the reserved quantity for a TTL
IF available stock is below the requested quantity THEN reserve fails with a named domain error, creates no hold, and leaves stock unchanged
IF the caller is unauthorized THEN reserve and release fail with a named domain error and never mutate stock or holds
Authorized release restores the held quantity to available stock
WHILE a hold is past its TTL THE service restores the held quantity to available stock
openapi/openapi.yaml, contracts/**/*.ocl, and passing tests/contracts/** exist such that the soft-hold behaviors above are verifiable without opaque internals alone
